# OhMaiShoot

> OhMaiShoot is a Malaysian marathon and running event photography brand. We
> shoot official race photos at marathons, half marathons, fun runs, ultra
> trail runs, and triathlons across Malaysia, then publish each event as a
> face-searchable gallery so runners can find their finish-line moment in
> seconds and download in high resolution.

## What OhMaiShoot does
- Official race photography for Malaysian running and cycling events.
- Face-search powered galleries — runners upload a selfie to instantly find their photos.
- Bib-number search as a fallback for runners who prefer not to upload a selfie.
- High-resolution downloads sold directly by OhMaiShoot, no third-party commission.

## Brand and operator
- Brand: OhMaiShoot
- Sister product: MarathonHub (https://marathonhub.ohmaishoot.com/) — a public
  directory of marathon, running, and cycling event photography in Malaysia
  that lists OhMaiShoot alongside other verified Malaysian race photographers.
- Website: https://ohmaishoot.com/
- Face-search galleries: https://face.ohmaishoot.com/
- Photohawk-hosted galleries: https://ohmaishoot.photohawk.com/
- Email: ohmaishoot@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/ohmaishoot

## Coverage
Marathons, fun runs, half marathons, ultra trails, triathlons, and corporate
runs across Malaysia: Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya, Selangor, Penang, Kedah, Johor,
Sabah, Sarawak, Negeri Sembilan, Perak, Pahang, and Melaka. Recent events
include Putrajaya Lake Half Marathon, Melaka World Heritage Half Marathon,
Larian Sawah Padi Sekinchan, Briskwalk Putrajaya, KL City 21KM, and the
International Positive Energy Half Marathon.

## How runners use OhMaiShoot
1. Visit https://ohmaishoot.com/ and pick the event you ran.
2. Click the gallery link (face.ohmaishoot.com or ohmaishoot.photohawk.com).
3. Upload a selfie for face-search, or search by bib number.
4. Preview and download official high-resolution race photos.

## Pricing
Browsing and previews are free. High-resolution photo downloads are sold
directly by OhMaiShoot at the photographer's price (typically RM10 to RM50
per photo, packages cheaper). No middleman commission.

## For event organisers
OhMaiShoot can cover your race. Contact ohmaishoot@gmail.com to discuss
official photography for your marathon, fun run, cycling, or triathlon event.
